property_summary: For any role, getRoleAdmin should return the admin role previously set via _setRoleAdmin or default; the mutant always returns bytes32(0), so after setting a non-zero admin role for a role, the reference returns the set admin role while the mutant returns bytes32(0).
change_summary: Rewrite getRoleAdmin to always return bytes32(0) (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) regardless of the role parameter.
